warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the reflecting species boundary in combination with the LBO operator: a wall-driven flow reversal and the collisional relaxation behind it. In `rt_vlasov_neut_lbo_wall.c`, `u0` (line 64) is the initial drift velocity toward the wall; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong reflecting boundary, a wrong LBO drag or diffusion coefficient changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 2.8e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 2.6e-4 (worst files `neut-imom.gkyl` and `neut-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 3619x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
